tech_civil_phanon_application.desc: Our engineers, architects and scientists have come up with some interesting new applications for our newly acquired runic power technology. This should open up new avenues of scientific progress for us!
tech_civil_phanon_application.name: Civil Phanon Engineering

tech_dark_matter_power_core_ae.desc:
Delta Technologies has provided us many insights regarding potential future of dark energy-based technology. Although we are getting more reasons to believe that the prior assumption that Dark Matter and Dark Energy are linked together may have been not entirely accurate, the name has struck and so we'll still be addressing as Dark Energy still for the time being.

Regardless, our scientists wish to start from a new, fresh perspective so the next stage of the reactor will be code-named "Alpha". This literation will see the increased usage of Dark Energy SR to balance out Dark Matter.

Researching this technology may agitate the fallen empires, as we are basically going to out-tech them.
tech_dark_matter_power_core_ae.name: Alpha-class Enigmatic Power

tech_dark_matter_power_core_dm.desc:
Now that we understand the concept of both Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it may soon be possible to create a much more powerful power source that surpasses that of Zero Point Reactor. Its revelation will open us the ways to many new possibilities.

Researching this technology may agitate the fallen empires, as we are basically going to out-tech them.
tech_dark_matter_power_core_dm.name: Delta-class Enigmatic Power

tech_dark_matter_power_core_se.desc:
With our current technology, it is now possible to create powerful equipment and tools to study stellaris properly. Although the true nature behind the specifics of Stellarite Power are still up for debate, none will argue that if this power has a potential to surpass Dark Matter.

WARNING: We do not yet fully comprehend the nature of this power, it is advised that we keep a careful control of this management.
tech_dark_matter_power_core_se.name: Stellarite Energy Application

technologies.desc: The ever-growing size of modern warships means that starbases will simply not cut it anymore when it comes to defending our territory, but logistical problems prevent a conventional defensive platform from getting too large. However, by embedding a defensive installation into a large asteroid, we can simultaneously solve the problems posed by recoil, as well as those caused by maintenance issue by integrating the structure's internals into the asteroid itself and mining it for resources whenever needed. This would effectively enable the construction of much larger and significantly more powerful defensive bastions.
technologies.name: Planetoid Defensive Operations

Pursuing further research into this field will lead to increasingly large warships.

technologies.desc: As leftovers from the formation of most solar systems, asteroids are rich in easily-accessible raw resources. Large constructs built around them equipped with specialized harvesters could be employed to steadily collect these resources, and ship them to planetside factories for processing or consumption.
technologies.name: Asteroidal Manufacturing Plants

technologies.desc: The Birch World was only a theoretical artificial construct intended for the most expansive of habitations, but it is now a reality. Built around the largest of black holes, these spacious shell worlds are specially made as to be built upon the event horizon of said black holes, at which level the surface gravity is comparable to the gravity of our home world.
technologies.name: The Birch World

technologies.desc: In addition to their esoteric FTL thrusters, Blokkat vessels employ these thrusters which push against the very fabric of our universe in order to boost the speed of their crafts even further.
technologies.name: Manifold Thrusters

technologies.desc: These extremely tough armor platings are made up of tightly-packed Planck length-sized particles. They form complex subatomic neural structures allowing the material to autonomously react to changes and adapt accordingly near-instantaneously.
technologies.name: Planckalloy Plating

technologies.desc: Studying the Blokkats' engineering methods and material science is an important step in understanding how their ships and technologies function.
technologies.name: Blokkat Engineering Study
unlockText:
Unlocks Engineering Repeatables granting Blokkat Knowledge
Blokkat Knowledge: +1

technologies.desc: With our newfound understanding of Blokkat technology granted by the Blokkilian Equations, we are now ready to truly prepare our ascension by establishing the necessary infrastructure to connect ourselves to the Blokkwork. Although these power nodes will not let us access the full extent of the Blokkwork for now (as it is not yet completely established over our galaxy), they will nonetheless let us greatly streamline our planetary operations by generating our own Blokkwork across our empire.
technologies.name: Blokkwork Power Nodes - Direct Blokkwork Connection

technologies.desc: Reactor boosters drawing additional energy from a higher-dimensional source. They also serve to improve the efficiency of the vessel as a whole.
technologies.name: Hyperdimensional Capacitor

technologies.desc: The application of Blokkat technologies to the artificial intelligence of our vessels will enable us to create truly terrifying vessels of war.
technologies.name: Blokkat Shipbound Computers

technologies.desc: Studying the Blokkats' hyperdimensional engineering methods is an important step towards complete understanding of these extragalactic invaders.
technologies.name: Blokkat Hyperdimensional Study
unlockText:
Unlocks Physics Repeatables granting Blokkat Knowledge
Blokkat Knowledge: +1

technologies.desc: The Pentafocused emitter is a titanic piercing weapon of Blokkat design, which is capable of "leaping" through a higher dimension in order to bypass the shielding and armor of energy vessels.
technologies.name: Pentafocused Emitter

technologies.desc: The Blokkats have long since converted their technologies to be based on the most fundamental aspect of the universe: energy. They utilize the Blokkwork to transfer vast quantities of energy across great distances and subsequently shape this energy into whatever they may require. Understanding how to base an entire civilization on the universe's most basic resource is paramount to solving the Blokkilian Equations.
technologies.name: Blokkilian Equations - Energy Primacy

technologies.desc: Studying how the Blokkats engineer their ships and materials is a difficult task to undertake remotely, but will provide valuable intel on their vessels and will likely help our science teams in designing new and innovating materials.
technologies.name: Blokkat Construction Techniques

technologies.desc: A colossal megastructure capable into the future to retrieve a star from another era of the universe might be what we need in order to undo the damage caused by the perfidious Blokkats.
technologies.name: Temporal Restoration

technologies.desc: There is no effective difference between a Blokkat thruster and a Blokkat FTL drive. They both employ a sort of device anchored through a higher dimension which quite literally "drags" the space surrounding the ship and moves it around with instantaneous acceleration.
technologies.name: Blokkat Phaseshift Transportation

technologies.desc: The Pylon's Power Core shall provide a direct link to the Blokkwork itself and enable the flow of near endless energy from the Blokkwork to our Blokkwork Power Node network.
technologies.name: Blokkwork Pylon - Dimensional Power Core
unlockText: Unlocks Megastructure: Pylon Dimensional Power Core

technologies.desc: The Pylon's frame is to be an intricate 6-dimensional construct embedded into the fabric of reality itself. Such a degree of sophistication is required if we are to bring the Blokkwork's full power into our galaxy.
technologies.name: Blokkwork Pylon - Hyperbranic Frame

technologies.desc: The analysis of the Blokkats' complex path intertwined with that of the Paluush will help us understand their mindset and technological evolution better.
technologies.name: Blokkat-Paluush Historiography Analysis

technologies.desc: Swarms of miniscule robots that serve as relays for the neural networks contained within Blokkat armors, increasing their efficiency and enabling them to repair faster. Blokkat models also transmit data to and from the Blokkwork for increased synchronization.
technologies.name: Subplanck Synchronizers

technologies.desc: How to properly coordinate harvesting operations spread over a significant portion of the observable universe involving the mass-energy of several galaxies being shipped across intergalactic distances? When one is running an operation as large as that of the Blokkats, inefficiency is simply unacceptable and logistics must thus be refined to perfection.
technologies.name: Blokkilian Equations - Intergalactic Logistics

technologies.desc: The Planck-Dismantlement Beam is a Blokkat device based on their stripmining apparatuses. Not only do these devices systematically dismantle the very fabric of enemy ships down to the subplanck level, reducing them to a slurry of hypercondensed quantum foam, they also collect said foam and store it aboard Blokkat vessels, where it can later be reprocessed into usable materials.
technologies.name: Planck-Dismantlement Beam

technologies.desc: The Hyperdimensional Stabilizer shall be one of the largest megastructures ever conceived, built for the sole purpose of bringing down the Blokkat-Vester's shield. Designing an appropriate construction site is a crucial step in the assembly of this colossal construct.
technologies.name: Early Hyperdimensional Destabilizer Schematics
unlockText: Unlocks Megastructure: Hyperdimensional Destabilizer Construction Site

technologies.desc: A special black hole employing methods very much like that of the Blokkats could be used to power the mighty Hyperdimensional Destabilizer and effectively enable it to strike at the Blokkats' seemingly unbreakable shield.
technologies.name: Pentadimensional Power Sources
unlockText: Unlocks Megastructure: Hyperdimensional Destabilizer Pentadimensional Converter

technologies.desc: By "skewing" the higher dimensions employed by the Blokkat Hyperdimensional Bulwark, we can forcefully bring it down one dimension, thus bringing it within the reach of our Pentadimensional Singularity.
technologies.name: Hyperdimensional Branebreaking

technologies.desc: Manipulating the sheer flow of energy required to bring down the Hyperdimensional Bulwark will require an untold number of higher-dimensional structures coupled with femtosecond-precision when it comes to executing the full sequence.
technologies.name: Yottascale Energy Manipulation

technologies.desc: The ability to strike at a target from both the past, the future and higher dimensions will ensure we can bring down the Hyperdimensional Bulwark down with much greater ease than before. Additionally, the wider application of this technology to our weapons systems will noticeably increase their potential damage output.
technologies.name: Applied Hypertemporal Chronodisruption

technologies.desc: These advanced launchers catapult a seeking four-dimensional singularity towards enemy ships. While they appear detached from Blokkat ships, these singularities are actually more akin to "lassos", as they are connected to Blokkat vessels through a higher dimension and are later "reeled back" by said vessels through this higher dimension after plowing through enemy ships. This enables the Blokkats to collect whatever the singularities destroyed and process it for later usage.
technologies.name: Tetradimensional Singularity Cannon

technologies.desc: The Evictor Ray is the largest Blokkat weapon encountered so far. This beam of untold power tears reality asunder and forcefully compresses its target into a 0-dimensional object by focusing the energies of several higher dimensions onto a localized area of the spacetime continuum, destroying it instantly.
technologies.name: Evictor Ray

technologies.desc: These hyperefficient point-defence systems shatter the very fabric of reality around enemy projectiles, obliterating them before they even get close to Blokkat vessels.
technologies.name: Blokk-Guardian Point-Defence System

technologies.desc: The Blokkat's hyperdimensional engineering methods are far more advanced than what we are currently capable of undertaking. If we were to study and understand them, the applications would be limitless.
technologies.name: 6-Dimensional Engineering Methods

technologies.desc: The Absolute Scorch Blaster fires a glob of plasma heated to the Planck Temperature, which is practically the highest possible temperature under known models of physics. The plasma is kept to these extreme temperatures by a constant influx of energy through a higher dimension and matter which comes in contact with the plasma is "absorbed" into said dimension, converted into energy in a way similar to how Blokkats harvest star systems and then fueled back into the plasma to further sustain the projectile's heat.
technologies.name: Absolute Scorch Blaster

technologies.desc: Blokkat ships are powered by these mysterious constructs that draw untold amounts of energy transferred from a higher dimension.
technologies.name: Blokkat Reactor

technologies.desc: By delicately altering the mind of a Blokkat using egregiously delicate and expensive methods, we might just be able to "switch" their allegiance from their original civilization to ours.
technologies.name: Blokkat Consciousness Alteration
unlockText:
Unlocks Feature: Blokkat reprogramming
Blokkat Knowledge: +1

technologies.desc: A slower and more careful approach to our utilization of Blokkat Scrap in our own vessels will yield more permanent results. The scrap can most notably be used to figure out ways to assault Blokkat vessels and structures from multiple dimensions at once.
technologies.name: Long-Term Blokkat Scrap Weaponization

technologies.desc: A slower and more careful approach to our analysis of Blokkat Scrap will yield more permanent results.
technologies.name: Long-Term Blokkat Scrap Analysis

technologies.desc: Studying the Blokkat Scrap recovered from destroyed Blokkat vessels is surely going to be a great boon to our Blokkat research.
technologies.name: Blokkat Scrap Analysis
unlockText:
Unlocks uses for Blokkat Scrap
Blokkat Knowledge: +1

technologies.desc: These Blokkat-designed sensors look for the oscillations that 3-dimensional matter creates within the higher-dimensional manifold of the universe.
technologies.name: Hyperbrane Sensors

technologies.desc: Much like the Blokkat-Vester's humongous shield, these smaller protective barriers rotate within a higher dimension, meaning only an infinitely small chunk of the full shield is ever exposed to enemy fire at once. If it is damaged, the damaged area is instantly shifted back into hyperdimensional space to be regenerated.
technologies.name: Hyperdimensional Shiftbarrier

technologies.desc: By severing individual Blokkats' connection to the Blokkwork and neutralizing them, we might be able to ultimately contain them provided we possess the necessary infrastructure to deny their escape. This will require the construction of a specialized holding cell surrounding the Blokkat within hyperdimensional space.
technologies.name: Blokkwork Severing Protocols
unlockText:
Unlocks Feature: Blokkat Capture
Unlocks Megastructure: Blokkat Containment Nexus

technologies.desc: The Blokkwork is a massive information and energy network hosted within a higher dimension which connects all Blokkats together. Decrypting and studying it would yield invaluable Blokkat-related data. Perhaps we can even apply the Blokkwork's methods to our own empire, as well.
technologies.name: Blokkwork Decryption Analysis

technologies.desc: Studying how Blokkat civilisation functions will be a critical step in learning how to best counter their terrifyingly advanced technologies.
technologies.name: Blokkat Sociology and Anatomy Studies
unlockText:
Unlocks Society Repeatables granting Blokkat Knowledge
Blokkat Knowledge: +1

technologies.desc: These spaceborne units heavily resemble actual Blokkats themselves and are geared for spaceship combat. They are most often remotely controlled by Blokkats within the mothership and are even sometimes Blokkats.
technologies.name: Blokk-Swarmer Units

technologies.desc: It is a known fact that the Blokkats no longer rely on baryonic matter to function, instead utilizing raw energy to create new types of elementary particles better fit for their operations. These particles can thus be extremely small and allow for their devices to be much, much denser than ones built using conventional particles. If we are to understand how they achieved such a feat, we must study how the Blokkats utilize the Blokkwork to spontaneously generate particles capable of projecting their will down to the Planck scale.
technologies.name: Blokkilian Equations - Planckscale Particle Generation

technologies.desc: The understanding and subsequent application of Blokkat femtosecond timetravel methods to effectively have a single item simultaneously undertake several operations in both the past and future is likely to be a great boon to both our own industry and Blokkat-related research.
technologies.name: Blokkat Temporal Displacement

technologies.desc: O-Stars are the brightest and most luminous stars in our galaxy. In order to assemble a Matrioshka Brain around one of these behemoths, we will have to design a megastructure that is both larger and more resistant than regular Matrioshka Brain, and be able to endure the extremely harsh stellar heat emitted by this type of star.
technologies.name: Matrioshka Brain Suprainsulation

technologies.desc: Rare crystals are often formed when extreme pressures meet extreme temperatures within the interior of celestial bodies. It's then up to random chance to bring them up to the surface, where they can be harvested by us. However, this luck factor can be eliminated by boring straight through a world's crust, and directly harvesting the precious crystals from there!
technologies.name: Core Crystal Harvesting

technologies.desc: Improving the infrastructure of our Planetary Defense Nexuses enables us to fit more Strike Corvettes within the megastructure's frame.
technologies.name: Enlarged Hangar Infrastructure

technologies.desc: Continued development of hangar designs means we can fit significantly more Strike Corvettes within the same volume.
technologies.name: Multi-Layered Hangars Systems

technologies.desc: As they lack an FTL Drive, Strike Corvettes can afford to carry much heavier and potent weaponry compared to their regular brethren. Capitalizing on this advantage will ensure they remain competitive with the ever-growing strength of space fleets.
technologies.name: Enhanced Strike Corvette Payloads
unlockText:
Strike Corvette Damage: +40%
Strike Corvette HP: +25%

technologies.desc: With our great improvements regarding hangar optimization, we can afford to make our Strike Corvettes significantly larger and bulkier than before.
technologies.name: Strike Corvette Upscaling
unlockText:
Strike Corvette Damage: +60%
Strike Corvette HP: +60%

technologies.desc: Minute improvements in the assembly process of our Strike Corvettes yield noticeable results in their final assembly rate, ensuring accelerated production.
technologies.name: Streamlined Planetary Vessel Assembly

technologies.desc: We can further increase the rate at which our Planetary Defense Nexuses assemble their vessels by enabling said vessels to effectively build themselves.
technologies.name: Strike Corvette Self-Assembly

technologies.desc: A citizen's life can be hard and exhausting. Covering a nearby moon with crystal plates and underground spotlights would create a device capable of projecting magnificent auroras and lights into a planet's sky. Such majestic effects would surely have a positive impact on our people's morale!
technologies.name: Hyperscale Refracting Apparatuses

technologies.desc: O-Stars are the brightest and most luminous stars in our galaxy. If we are to assemble a Dyson Sphere around one of these behemoths, we will have to design a megastructure that is both larger and more resistant than regular Dyson Spheres, and be able to endure the extremely harsh stellar heat emitted by this type of star.
technologies.name: Dyson Sphere Suprainsulation

technologies.desc: While the deeper nature of the Sirens' mysterious song still eludes us, preliminary studies suggest that firing focused discharges of energy at specific frequencies into quasi-space can mitigate some of the Strife Field's effects, at the cost of drastically increasing the upkeep of the ships these mechanisms are mounted on.
technologies.name: Early Sirens Countermeasures

technologies.desc: More careful attuning of the Disenchanter mechanisms allow for more efficient countering of the Strife Field's nefarious effects.
technologies.name: Disenchanter Tuning

technologies.desc: Breakthroughs in our understand of the Strife Field's enable us to directly emit counter-melodies to the Sirens' songs within the Immaterium itself, which can ward off even the nefarious Inner Field's mind-controlling effects.
technologies.name: Subpsionic Symphonies
unlockText: Allows capture of Starbases and Planets in the Inner Field.

technologies.desc: Our understanding of the Sirens' song has now progressed to the point where we can comfortably nullify their mind-controlling field at any scale, albeit at a non-negligible energy cost.
technologies.name: Euphonic Strife Dissipation

technologies.desc: Replicating the esoteric workings of Helios' infernal core within a controlled environment and on an industrial scale enables tremendous energy production and the facilitated production of heavy elements.
technologies.name: Industrial Psicatalyzed Fusion

technologies.desc: These artilleries fire large crystalline projectiles imbued with excess psionic energy rendering them somewhat unstable and thus very effective against general enemy defenses.
technologies.name: Crystalline Artillery

technologies.desc: These autocannons spray a flurry of razor-sharp thaumaturgic crystals which, while they struggle to puncture thick armor and are generally stopped clean by shields, can absolutely devastate the more fragile hull of energy starships if it happens to be exposed.
technologies.name: Crystalline Autocannon

technologies.desc: The Crystalline Impactor relies on thaumaturgic crystals imbued with partial sentience in order to produce devastating seeking projectiles at extremely high velocities meant to damage and penetrate armor.
technologies.name: Crystalline Impactor

technologies.desc: This unorthodox missile design relies on a ball of charged thaumaturgic crystals lobbed through the void of space. Guided by a partial sentience wishing only to see the destruction of its opponents, it can slip through shields and armor alike in order to cause maximum carnage upon its beloathed foes.
technologies.name: Thaumaturgic Charge

technologies.desc: Studying how the Sirens unleash their enthralling spell could have great application for our government and society.
technologies.name: Thaumaturgic Enthrallment

technologies.desc: Instead of being more conventional assault strike crafts, these high-health fighters exist only to overwhelm, harass and disorient enemy strike craft and PD systems, thus helping our other weapons inflict more damage.
technologies.name: Harass Decoys

technologies.desc: This gargantuan beam has the interest effect of psionically-maximizing the entropy of its target, rendering it very efficient against shielding systems.
technologies.name: Grand Void Beam

technologies.desc: The esoteric nature of thaumaturgic weaponry means there is essentially no upper limit on their potential. As long as more energy can be pumped in alongside more crystals to carry that energy, they can continue getting more and more powerful.

technologies.name: Relativistic Singularity Harvesting

The Hyperstructural Assembly Yard would be an absolutely gargantuan structure built around a star, consisting of an inner stellar-lifting ring and an outer shipyard ring, similar to the Equatorial Shipyard. This humongous construct would provide immense ship-building capabilities, as well as vast amounts of naval capacity.

technologies.desc: We have mastered the art of constructing ringworlds that don't require much natural heat to function. The next logical step is to take this to the extreme and upgrade our Interstellar Habitats with massive ringworlds!
technologies.name: Interstellar Ring Worlds

technologies.desc: The study of the Kaiser Moon has allowed us to recreate the superweapon's blueprints. With much heavier armaments than a regular Attack Moon, the Kaiser Moon is a fearsome superweapon that would undoubtedly dominate the stellar battlefield.

technologies.desc: The ability to generate a Kugelblitz could prove useful, as such objects could be used as efficient singularity generators. Most importantly, controlled Kugelblitzes could be fed matter and energy for later recovery, effectively acting as a Black Hole storage device.
technologies.name: Artificial Kugelblitz Containment

technologies.desc: O-Stars are the brightest and most luminous stars in our galaxy. If we are to assemble a Star Lifter around one of these behemoths, we will have to design a megastructure that is both larger and more resistant than regular Star Lifters, and be able to endure the extremely harsh stellar heat emitted by this type of star.
technologies.name: Star Lifter Suprainsulation

technologies.desc: By employing a plethora of methods such as Tetradimensional Engineering and nanites, it becomes possible to quickly and efficiently rearrange large quantities of planetary matter into whatever we want. This effectively enables us to create our own Attack Moons without the need for a naturally-occurring planetoid to build it on, provided we harvest enough planetary matter beforehand.
technologies.name: Lunar-Scale Fabrication Protocols

technologies.desc: Construction of a facility dedicated to creating massive storms within the atmosphere of gas giants could allow us to study the effects far better than any natural storms. The applications of such storm research are very promising.
technologies.name: Macro-Atmospheric Weather Manipulation

In addition, a Dead Hand system will be developed to deter enemy Colossus-class warships. The planetary building is necessary to begin Maginot World construction, but the building can also be built in other locations not suitable for full development.

By exploiting the physics-defying nature of neutron stars alongside advanced spacetime manipulation, it becomes possible to utilize a neutron star's properties to facilitate mineral refining processes, making the mass-production of alloys trivial. Those alloys, when mixed with harvested neutronium, could then be transformed into the purest and most powerful weapons ever designed by a sapient species, capable of bending spacetime itself. This would require a colossal ring structure built around a neutron star, employing the most advanced technologies known to the galaxy.

technologies.desc: Spinning Black Holes have such powerful gravitational fields that they literally drag spacetime along with them while rotating. technologies.desc: By using specialized stabilizers and modulators, it becomes possible to drastically increase the amount of controlled radiation a Penrose Sphere can contain, drastically increasing its output.

technologies.desc: Theoretically, it might be possible to assemble a ringworld powered by a Penrose Sphere. technologies.desc: A grand upscaling of Lunar Macro-Fabrication methods can enable us to fabricate entire Behemoth Planetcrafts instead of mere Attack Moons. It might seem ludicrous, but it might just be possible provided we harvest sufficient planetary matter beforehand.

technologies.desc: The solution to ever-expanding needs for computing power: an entire planet transformed into a computer! Using specialized terraforming techniques, this seemingly silly project can become a reality.

technologies.desc: Barren worlds, both hot and cold, often feature the basic building blocks of life, merely not in the proper arrangement. However, with the discovery of Cutholoids and Amoebas thriving in the depths of space, there now lies the possibility of creating bespoke artificial 'lifeforms' which, once deposited on lifeless worlds, will be able to accumulate and rearrange these building blocks into various substances suitable for harvest and consumption. As all these would do is shuffle and rearrange scattered molecules into various edible compounds, these would have to be regularly replenished and would not constitute a proper 'biosphere', but could provide a useful supply of materials to our nutrition industries.
technologies.name: Large-Scale Extremophile Sustenance

technologies.name: Hyperdimensional Shielding

technologies.desc: The Hyperquasar at the galactic core is surrounded by a massive and extremely energetic accretion disk. This disk obviously makes it impossible to assemble anything in the quasar's vicinity. However, by altering the gravitational constant near the quasar, we could effectively simulate an increase in the object's mass, which would force the disk to shrink to a smaller size. This would in effect both increase its energetic potential, and allow us to construct a structure much closer to the quasar.
technologies.name: Gravitational Accretion Compression
unlockText: Unlocks Megastructure: Quasi-Stellar Obliterator Phase 1: Accretion Compressor

technologies.desc: One of the supermassive quasar's most prominent feature is the presence of two gigantic jets, consisting of hyperaccelerated jets of ionised matter shooting out from both poles at relativistic speeds. Such systems include power generation, lifeform cataloguing, gravitational stabilization and so on. While they are currently stored in a dedicated ringworld segment neighboring the habitable segment, sufficiently advanced technologies might make it possible to store most of those systems within the habitable ringworld segment itself, drastically increasing the capacity of our ringworlds. The Decision should be made on the ringworld segment you wish to upgrade

This also allows for the creation of materials capable of withstanding absolutely ridiculous amounts of stress.

technologies.desc: Our Systemcraft needs the best of weapons. Combining several spacetime disruption technologies could allow for the creation of an energy lance which would carry such immense power drawn from the star itself that no target could hope to withstand it.

unlockText: Unlocks Megastructure: Stellar Systemcraft Phase 4: Celestial Erasers

technologies.desc: Some exotic physical phenomena may not be explainable with quantum-theoretical or string-theoretical approaches alone. A new branch of physics called "Abstract Physics", which makes use of extremely unconventional methods and approaches, may lead to answers for even the most absurd phenomena of the universe and beyond.
technologies.name: Abstract Physics Theory

weightModifiers.conditions: NOR = { has_trait_in_council = { TRAIT = leader_trait_expertise_particles } has_trait_in_council = { TRAIT = leader_trait_curator } has_trait_in_council = { TRAIT = leader_trait_spark_of_genius } has_trait_in_council = { TRAIT = leader_trait_maniacal } }

technologies.desc: The extremely efficient approaches of abstract physics are aiding us well in explaining even the universe's most bizarre phenomena. Using these approaches to find novel breakthroughs may give us access to unique and powerful technologies.
technologies.name: Applied Abstract Physics

technologies.desc: As abstract physics is very different to other branches of physics, it necessitates customized mathematical formalism to efficiently express it. This "Quoudroplean Formalism" makes use of truly alien mathematical frameworks and theorems that don't fit into the classical universe of mathematics and were thought to be entirely inapplicable and inadequate for reality.
technologies.name: Quoudroplean Formalism

technologies.desc: The transportation of information, matter and energy in non-abstract physics is strictly bound to the speed of causality, which in itself is limited and relatively small compared to the size of the universe. Faster-than-causality transmission can only be achieved in circumstances where no information is transmitted or spacetime is bent. However, in abstract physics, the boundaries between fixed rules and unfixed potentialities are themselves fluid and shifting. There are certain ways to work around these rules, change them, or even simply ignore them. As absurd as it may appear.
technologies.name: Non-paradoxical Information Supercausality

technologies.desc: Extremely high energy states lead to the unification of the electromagnetic and weak forces into their initial force, the electroweak force. The secrets of the Everchanging revealed how to manifest physical "Electroweak Quasi-Fields", which open up possibilities for tremendously precise field and spacetime manipulation, even down to the level of quantum foam itself.
technologies.name: Electroweak Quasi-Field Materialization

technologies.desc: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator and squeezed electromagnetic fields to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes. Due to their indeterministic behavior, their destinations are largely beyond our control.
technologies.name: E.H.O.F. Alpha

technologies.desc: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, photonic matter, and negative pressure to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes. The photonic matter and negative pressure enhance the entire process, increasing the Event Horizon Offset Facility's precision and expanding its range of destinations.
technologies.name: E.H.O.F. Lambda

technologies.desc: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, hardlight constructs, sterile sub-neutrino detectors, and negative mass to manipulate and inflate micro wormholes. The utilization of negative mass induces total stabilization of wormholes, which allows us to keep the inflated micro wormholes open for as long as we see fit. The sterile sub-neutrino detectors further expand the range of destinations our micro wormholes can reach.
technologies.name: E.H.O.F. Omega

technologies.desc: Utilizing the mysteries of the Everchanging, the E.H.O.F. Ultima is the perfect form of the Event Horizon Offset Facility, capable of traveling to any location of our choosing without limitations and risks. Limitless possibilities await.
technologies.name: E.H.O.F. Ultima

technologies.desc: The first generation of Sentient Metal technology was developed through intensive study of the Enigmatic Pattern transmitters and Primordial Pillars. It is focused on an industrial structure that will replicate Sentient Metal.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Tier I

technologies.desc: The second generation of Sentient Metal technology concerns both employing the material to create starship-grade armor, and a new type of flak battery turret that uses the material's networked intelligence to effectively target and neutralize incoming projectiles.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Tier II

technologies.desc: The third generation of Sentient Metal technology has allowed further refinement of existing armor designs, and designs for a new type of railgun that makes use of the material to both target and damage enemy vessels.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Tier III

technologies.desc: The fourth generation of Sentient Metal technologies concerns both a new type of artillery system utilizing the material, and a ship computer based on the material's networked intelligence.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Tier IV

technologies.desc: The fifth generation of Sentient Metal technologies includes a new type of autocannon, and an improved fabrication lab that can produce even more of the material.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Tier V

technologies.desc: The sixth generation of Sentient Metal technologies is compromised of a new type of spinal-mounted cannon, further revisions to the armor designs, and a power core that taps into the energy source of the Primordial Pillars to provide enormous amounts of energy.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Tier VI

technologies.desc: The seventh generation of Sentient Metal technologies, developed as a result of our study of the secrets of the Everchanging. It is compromised of the technology for a new type of titan-sized-turret, which makes use of Sentient Metal for aiming at targets, tracking them and damaging them, and an even more advanced type of the Sentient Metal armor.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Tier VII

technologies.desc: This device, mounted on the spine of an Arkship, utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, squeezed electromagnetic fields, photonic matter, and negative pressure to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes.
technologies.name: Horizon Drive

technologies.desc: The discovery of non-paradoxical supercausality has led to the development of an immensely efficient and powerful energy distributor. This system utilizes field entanglement energy transregulation to transport tremendous amounts of energy from anywhere to everywhere.
technologies.name: Field Entanglement Energy Transregulation

technologies.desc: We must refit our defensive perimeter stations to take advantage of new developments in starbase construction.
technologies.name: Starhold Defensive Perimeter
unlockText: Unlocks Feature: Defense Station Starhold Upgrade

technologies.desc: Starhold Defensive Perimeter
technologies.name: Star Fortress Defensive Perimeter
unlockText: Unlocks Feature: Defense Station Star Fortress Upgrade

technologies.name: Citadel Defensive Perimeter
unlockText: Unlocks Feature: Defense Station Citadel Upgrade

technologies.desc: The best defense... is a good defense.
technologies.name: Defensive Perimeter Maginot Doctrine
unlockText: Unlocks Feature: Defense Station Maginot Upgrade

technologies.desc: Advances in mineral scanning allow us to more rapidly and accurately assess potential harvesting candidates.
technologies.name: High-Resolution Asteroid Surveys

technologies.desc: Applying newly developed mining lasers to asteroid harvesting will allow more efficient disassembly.
technologies.name: Improved Asteroid Disassembly

technologies.desc: Automated mining drone fleets, originally designed to harvest minerals, can also be applied to our larger material collection efforts.
technologies.name: Autonomous Disassembly Drones

technologies.desc: Improving support equipment and infrastructure for our planetary expeditions allows them to more effectively identify resource extraction opportunities.
technologies.name: Planetary Expedition Infrastructure

technologies.desc: By creating a mass-energy repulsive layer around a planet's atmosphere through the utilization of Negative Mass, this structure shields a planet from even the most intense orbital bombardment. Only long-term bombardment and extremely high energy beams can penetrate the repulsive layer in time.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Protector

weightModifiers.conditions: NOR = { has_trait_in_council = { TRAIT = leader_trait_expertise_field_manipulation } has_trait_in_council = { TRAIT = leader_trait_curator } has_trait_in_council = { TRAIT = leader_trait_spark_of_genius } }

technologies.desc: High energy pair-annihilation processes are not 100% efficient. The more massive an annihilated particle pair, the more likely the output is less massive particles rather than photons. A new generation of power plants make use of abstract physics to extract the kinetic energy of these decay particles to further increase the efficiency of antimatter-matter annihilation energy generation processes.
technologies.name: Decay Particle Kinetic Energy Extraction

technologies.desc: Besides the generation of power via active zero-point energy siphoning utilized in reactors, we can use a passive method of siphoning in specialized power plants. This enables us the extraction of zero-point energy in regular power plants, increasing their efficiency beyond 100%.
technologies.name: Passive Zero-Point Energy Siphoning

technologies.desc: Gravitational waves may be extremely hard to detect, but they contain tremendous amounts of energy. Even small masses release large amounts of gravitational energy in form of these waves. Advanced abstract physics techniques allow us to directly extract energy from gravitational waves, thus making a new generation of reactors and power plants possible.
technologies.name: Gravitational Wave Energy Extraction

technologies.desc: Dominion over the electromagnetic field will grant us the ability to create pure hardlight constructs, advanced and powerful extensions of photonic matter. These constructs will be able to directly manipulate elementary particles and thus provide even further control of matter and energy.
technologies.name: Hardlight Construct Utilization

technologies.desc: Advances in abstract physics enable the development of ultra-high-capacity hyperlane power transmitters that allow for fast and efficient interstellar energy transmission.
technologies.name: Hyperlane Power Transmission

technologies.desc: The extremely militaristic and nuclear-loving Katzens have managed to destroy the surfaces of both Katzenland and Flusion with remarkable ease and efficiency. They seemed to employ a vast array of different explosives in order to deal as much damage as possible, ranging from radioactive fission warheads, to antimatter bombs, and biochemical weaponry. By adopting their methods, our ships could be made to completely devastate enemy worlds with ease.
technologies.name: Katzen Atomic Munitions

technologies.desc: High-energy laser conduction energy distributors allow for interplanetary energy transport and exchange, increasing the efficiency of our empire's power distribution.
technologies.name: Light Conduction Distribution Systems

technologies.desc: Negative energy has been a purely hypothetical, controversial, and extremely abstract topic for a long time... at least until the discovery of the mind-bending negative mass. Abstract physics will allow us to further study this seemingly impossible, yet undeniably real, phenomenon.
technologies.name: Negative Energy Studies

technologies.desc: Negative pressure is a phenomenon that has been observed before at the quantum level, in the form of the Casimir effect. There, it manifests in form of vacuum fluctuations, but is uncontrollable. Applied abstract physics has lead to the discovery of better-applicable and more efficient ways to generate and control negative pressure.
technologies.name: Negative Pressure Application

technologies.desc: The first generation of devices, processes and methods that utilize negative mass. They are still experimental prototypes and don't utilize the full potential of negative mass, but are powerful nonetheless.
technologies.name: Prototype Negative Mass Utilities

technologies.desc: The potential of negative mass is vast. A deeper understanding of this bizarre resource enables the development and creation of even more advanced and powerful negative mass assets.
technologies.name: Advanced Negative Mass Utilities

technologies.desc: The supercausal phenomena of abstract physics require their own kind of advanced, complex, and powerful research facilities.
technologies.name: Supercausal Research Initiatives

technologies.desc: The ability to precisely manipulate electromagnetic wave interference patterns has allowed us to construct stable standing waves capable of interaction with the physical world in ways resembling mundane matter. This "photonic" matter shows great promise in micro-scale manipulation tasks, and will be invaluable in the field of shield harmonics.
technologies.name: Photonic Matter Utilization

technologies.desc: Unimaginably sensitive tachyon sensors, based on and aided by the astonishing capabilities of the sentient metal hive-intellect, determine the target of a micro wormhole before it even emerges in real space. This prediction of wormhole targets increases the precision of Event Horizon Offset Facility travel to a seemingly impossible degree. With this technology, our Event Horizon Offset Facility will be able to form a micro wormhole connecting it to any destination in the galaxy.
technologies.name: Micro Wormhole Destination Precognition

technologies.desc: The Negative Mass Emitter fires a scatter-shot of randomly polarized and spun negative mass rays, to which dedicated defenses are nothing but more hull.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Emitter

technologies.desc: The Negative Mass Disruptor fires waves of tremendously destructive negative mass which decohere large swathes of matter. Unfortunately, these waves dissipate after a short distance.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Disruptor

conditions: Giga special tech compound weapon bypass

technologies.desc: The Negative Mass Lance fires a continuous ray of negative mass, tearing apart even the most reinforced material defenses at the subatomic (or equivalent) level.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Lance

technologies.desc: Negative Mass Torpedoes use the repulsive force of negative mass to amplify the destructive power of our packed neutron warheads.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Torpedoes

technologies.desc: The Jump Drive is already an unbelievable invention on its own, but with the unique properties of negative mass, we were able to enhance it even further! By infusing a ship with the substance at the moment of a jump, we can massively reduce the vessel's mass, and consequently, the amount of energy required to translate it across space. This allows us to travel farther and more routinely on the same basic Jump Drive design.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Jump Drive Enhancements
unlockText: Unlocks Component: Negative Mass Jump Drive Enhancements

technologies.desc: The Negative Mass Laser employs a focused negative mass conduit to decohere any form of matter, baryonic or otherwise.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Laser

technologies.desc: The Negative Mass Point Defense fires an expanding wave of negative mass towards incoming projectiles, throwing them off-course.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Point Defense

technologies.desc: The Negative Mass Pseudoplasma Launcher fires coherent spheres of negative mass that explosively disrupt any form of matter they strike.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Pseudoplasma Launcher

technologies.desc: Negative mass reactors utilize polarized flows of the substance and "normal" energy to achieve near-perfect annihilation and commiserately massive power output.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Reactors

technologies.desc: Negative mass allows us to augment our existing sensors by creating much more precise signal filters, resulting in improved scan resolution and fleet detection.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Sensors

technologies.desc: Negative mass shields actively repel matter and energy striking them rather than simply dissipating the source at its point of impact.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Shields

technologies.desc: Research into negative mass has allowed us to expand its usage within our empire. The substance's exotic properties theoretically allow for non-hyperdrive based FTL travel, but the more mundane properties of our ship architecture mean that we have to settle for thrusters that simply go really, really fast.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Thrusters

technologies.desc: The Negative Mass Beam is a titanic focused ray that decoheres vast swathes of matter in a single hit.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Beam

technologies.desc: The Compound is a threat to all life in the galaxy, and possibly even beyond. Our tests have shown that negative mass is the only thing we know of that can harm them. From this lead, we have begun to develop energy weapons that employ negative mass so that we can finally fight back.
technologies.name: Negative Mass Enhancements

technologies.desc: The discoveries made through the study of the planet-plant brain led to the development of artificial quasi-neural networks. These allow us to perform alternate and unknown methods of data-transmission and data-management in various application areas.
technologies.name: Quasi-Neural Networks

swaps.displayName: Large Scale Self Replicating Deconstruction Swarms
swaps.name: giga_tech_ring_world_swap_no_habitables

technologies.desc: The Scarlet Scourge is an advanced synthetic toxin that could either be used as a terraforming agent, as originally intended, or as a planet-enveloping chemical weapon capable of destroying all life. Its use is up to us.
technologies.name: Scourge Deployment

technologies.desc: Sentient metal reconstitutes and replicates when damaged, dynamically adapting to environmental effects. This makes it a perfect substance for armor.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Armor

technologies.desc: By constructing the hulls of our ships out of material which contain traces of sentient metal and material reservoirs, our ships can self-repair with extreme efficiency.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Hull Regeneration

technologies.desc: The Sentient Metal Ripper shoots numerous tiny sentient metal spikes, each programmed to assimilate any form of matter they come into contact with, then condensing into a sphere and disconnecting from its point of contact.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Ripper

conditions: Giga special tech compound weapon bypass

technologies.desc: The capacities of the Sentient Metal hive mind are tremendous and far beyond even our most powerful information processing networks. By directly connecting it to the systems of our ships and structures, we can implement superordinate orders for it to control our ships and stations like no other ship computer before.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Intellect

technologies.desc: The Sentient Metal Flak Battery utilizes the material's local network intelligence to aim more precisely and accurately at incoming projectiles than we were ever able before.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Flak Battery

technologies.desc: The Sentient Metal Artillery amalgamates and then fires a large spike of Sentient Metal programmed to absorb any form of matter it comes into contact with. Fighters and small ships are immediately assimilated; larger ships sustain heavy damage as sentient metal rips chunks out of their hull.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Artillery

technologies.desc: The Sentient Metal Absorber launches enormous Sentient Metal spikes, often large enough to fully assimilate smaller ships in a single shot.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Absorber

technologies.desc: The Sentient Metal Railgun amalgamates and then fires a small sentient metal spike programmed to absorb any form of matter it comes into contact with. Once the projectile reaches a certain threshold of absorbed material, it condenses into a sphere and decouples.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Railgun

technologies.desc:
MEGASTRUCTURE - STRATEGIC RESOURCE PRODUCTION
The Sentient Metal Forge siphons material from the Everchanging, creating massive quantities of Sentient Metal and Quasi-Negative Mass, and increasing the productivity of our empire's [ehof_cultivator.GetIcon] [ehof_cultivator.GetNamePlural].
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Forge

technologies.desc: The Sentient Metal Devourer doesn't directly utilize sentient metal to damage its targets. Rather, it uses the material's connection to the Everchanging, along with the Enigmatic Pattern, to have the Everchanging open a power transfer micro wormhole. It directs the resultant colossal outpouring of energy towards enemy vessels.
technologies.name: Sentient Metal Devourer

technologies.desc: A unique form of exotic dark matter originating from hyperspace, sterile hyper-neutrinos radiate from the opening of micro wormholes. They possess unique frequencies related to the location that the micro wormholes lead to. By analyzing these frequencies, we can predict the target of an micro wormhole with much higher precision, increasing the accuracy of our Event Horizon Offset Facility.
technologies.name: Sterile Hyper-Neutrino Detection

technologies.desc: The unconventional approaches and principles of abstract physics require the construction of new research facilities to develop alternative investigation methods for the comprehension of reality.
technologies.name: Unorthodox Reality Examination Techniques
